## Sheet S1 — Chim Sẻ Sấm (enemy_gale_sparrow): bay, đập cánh

```text

Copy its art style exactly: a dark warm-brown outline (never black) of even weight, soft cel shading with one shadow tone and one highlight tone, light from the top-left, warm pastel colours of medium saturation, a subtle painted texture, rounded chunky friendly shapes, low-to-medium detail. Do NOT copy the objects of image 1.
Image 2 is the accepted look of this exact creature (Chim Sẻ Sấm) in its IDLE pose: match its shape, colours and shading closely, but leave out any text or letters.
Image 3 only shows the SHAPE idea for the layout of the four cells and the wing positions of one wingbeat: one creature per cell, same size, cell 1 as in image 2, cells 2 to 4 the three moving frames in this order. Ignore its style completely (its heavy outline, glossy look, cloud pedestal and captions are wrong for my game).

Draw ONE image: a sheet of 4 separate game sprites in a clean grid of 1 row(s) x 4 column(s), in exactly this order, left to right, top to bottom:
Row 1: (1) IDLE pose — the same pose as image 2, standing on its feet; (2) FLY frame 1 — flying to the right, feet tucked under the body, BOTH wings raised high above the back (the top of the wingbeat); (3) FLY frame 2 — flying, both wings stretched straight out to the sides, level with the body, feathers spread (the middle of the wingbeat); (4) FLY frame 3 — flying, both wings swept down below the body (the bottom of the wingbeat), tail feathers fanned.
All four cells show the SAME single creature: Chim Sẻ Sấm, a round little grey-and-yellow songbird with a cream chest, a grey crest with yellow lightning-zigzag stripes and a small dark beak, the creature shown in image 2. Keep it IDENTICAL to image 2: the same colours, markings, crest, zigzag stripes, feather colours, beak, feet and body proportions, drawn at the SAME scale as in image 2.
Cells 2, 3 and 4 are the three in-between frames of ONE flying wingbeat cycle, played 2 → 3 → 4 → 3 in a loop: the creature stays in the SAME place, at the SAME size, with the SAME calm face as image 2 in all of them; ONLY the wings (and the tail feathers a little) change from cell to cell (a tiny bob of the body is fine). EVERY cell faces RIGHT (three-quarter view looking to the right, like image 2).
In image 2 one wing is already lifted as a greeting; in cells 2 to 4 BOTH wings move together as one wingbeat.
A character animation sheet: each cell holds the whole creature once, at the SAME size in every cell; in cell 1 it stands on an invisible ground line at the bottom of the cell, in cells 2, 3 and 4 it flies at exactly the same height, a little above that line, about 70 % of the cell height tall with its wings fully inside the cell. Clear silhouette. No props, effects, motion lines, dust, water, bubbles, stars or text around it.

Every object is fully visible and centred in its own cell, with wide empty gaps between objects; nothing touches, overlaps or crosses into another cell. Wide landscape image.
Background: one plain flat light-grey colour (#C8C8C8) everywhere. No gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast shadow on the background.
No text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, watermark, logo, border or frame. Not glossy, not a 3D render, not flat vector, not pixel art. No glow, no sparkles, no floating particles.
```
